chunks: when he placed his foot in the stirrup, say:
"Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, and we could not have done so on our own."
And he would glorify Allah seven times, praise Allah seven times, and declare Allah's oneness seven times.

key_terms.الرِّكَابِ: the stirrup used when mounting a ride
key_terms.سَخَّرَ: subjected or made serviceable by divine power
key_terms.سُبْحَانَ: glorification of Allah above all imperfection
key_terms.مُقْرِنِينَ: capable of controlling or mastering it by ourselves
key_terms.يُهَلِّلُ: he says the tahlil, affirming Allah’s oneness

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say when placing his foot in the stirrup?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the supplication and dhikr recited by Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام when mounting a ride. It centers on acknowledging Allah’s favor in subjecting transportation to human use, followed by repeated tasbih, tahmid, and tahlil as acts of devotion and gratitude.
